briefing.ja: 大学のサークル部室で、棚に飾ってあった優勝トロフィーが、そっくりの安物レプリカに入れ替えられていた。入れ替えは18時から18時30分の間に起きている。その時間に部室と廊下にいた6人のうち1人が犯人であり、その人の証言カードには嘘が1枚だけ混ざっている。全員の証言を突き合わせて、誰の話が成り立たないかを見つける。
briefing.en: The club trophy on the shelf was swapped for a cheap replica between 18:00 and 18:30. One of the six people in the club room and the corridor did it, and one card in that person's hand is a lie.

text.2: From the doorway I could see the corridor until 18:15.
text.3: I stood at the club room door and could see the corridor until about fifteen past.
text.4: From where I stood, I could see anyone who went by in the corridor, at least until a quarter past.
text.5: My mind was half on other things, but from the club room door I could see the corridor until about fifteen minutes past six.

facts.hintJa: corridor = 廊下 / doorway = 出入口 / go by = 通り過ぎる

text.3: I did not see anyone go down the stairs before twenty past six.
text.4: Had someone taken the stairs before twenty past, I think I would have noticed.
text.5: I would not put it too strongly, but I do not believe anyone went down the stairs before twenty minutes past six.

facts.hintJa: stairs = 階段 / go down = 下りる / notice = 気づく

text.2: The trophy was still on the shelf at 18:05.
text.3: The trophy was definitely still on that shelf at five past six.
text.4: The trophy was certainly still up there when I glanced at the shelf at five past.
text.5: The minute may be a little out, but the trophy was still on the shelf at around five past six.

facts.hintJa: trophy = 優勝カップ / shelf = 棚 / still = まだ

text.2: Nobody was watching the shelf from 18:10.
text.3: From about ten past six, nobody was keeping an eye on the shelf.
text.4: After ten past, nobody in the room had their eyes on that shelf.
text.5: The time is not something I can pin down, but from roughly ten minutes past six nobody was watching the shelf.

facts.hintJa: watch = 見張る / keep an eye on = 注意して見る / nobody = 誰も〜ない

text.2: From our doorway I saw the corridor from 18:10 to 18:20.
text.3: I could see the corridor from our doorway from ten past to twenty past.
text.4: Our doorway looks straight down the corridor, and I stood there from ten past to twenty past.
text.5: I was busy with our own gear, but our doorway looks down the corridor and I was there from ten past to twenty past.

facts.hintJa: next door = 隣の / gear = 道具 / look down = 見通す

text.1: Gear cases. Inside our door. 18:10 to 18:20.
text.2: Our gear cases were stacked inside our door from 18:10 to 18:20.
text.3: Our gear cases stood stacked just inside our door from ten past to twenty past.
text.4: Between ten past and twenty past, nobody was stepping into our room past that stack.
text.5: Ask me the minute and I could not say, but our gear cases were stacked just inside our door from ten past to twenty past.

facts.hintJa: case = 運搬用のケース / stack = 積み重ねる / past = 〜を越えて

text.2: My boxes blocked the club room door from 18:10 to 18:15.
text.3: My boxes stood in the club room doorway from ten past until fifteen past.
text.4: My boxes were in the way there from ten past to fifteen past, so nobody could have slipped through.
text.5: Nobody was timing me, but my boxes were standing in the club room doorway from about ten past until fifteen past six.

facts.hintJa: box = 段ボール箱 / block = ふさぐ / doorway = 出入口

text.1: My car. By the emergency exit. Until 18:25.
text.2: My car was parked by the emergency exit until 18:25.
text.3: My car stood right outside the emergency exit until twenty-five past.
text.4: Anyone coming out that way before twenty-five past would have found my car in the way.
text.5: I did not check my watch, but my car was standing right outside the emergency exit until about twenty-five past six.

facts.hintJa: park = 停める / outside = 外に / in the way = ふさいで

text.1: Equipment room door. I watched it. Until 18:20.
text.2: I had the equipment room door in sight until 18:20.
text.3: I kept the equipment room door in view until twenty past six.
text.4: I never lost sight of the equipment room door before twenty past, as far as I know.
text.5: I would not call it keeping watch exactly, but the equipment room door stayed within my sight until about twenty minutes past six.

facts.hintJa: equipment = 用具 / in sight = 見えるところに / keep = 〜し続ける

text.2: The club room window was shut between 18:00 and 18:25.
text.3: Nobody opened the window between six o'clock and twenty-five past.
text.4: Had the window been opened at any point up to twenty-five past, the cold air would have got in.
text.5: I do not fuss about it usually, but the club room window stayed shut between six o'clock and twenty-five past.

facts.hintJa: window = 窓 / shut = 閉まっている / cold air = 冷たい空気

text.1: Vending machine. Out of order. From 18:05.
text.2: The vending machine was out of order from 18:05.
text.3: The vending machine had been out of order since about five past six.
text.4: Anyone going for a drink would have found that machine dead after five past.
text.5: The minute is guesswork on my part, but the vending machine had been out of order since around five past six.

facts.hintJa: vending machine = 自動販売機 / out of order = 故障中 / dead = 動かない

text.2: The emergency exit was locked until 18:20.
text.3: The emergency exit stayed locked until twenty past six.
text.4: That door would not have opened for anyone before twenty past, however hard they pushed.
text.5: Short of checking my log, I would say the emergency exit stayed locked until at least twenty minutes past six.

facts.hintJa: emergency exit = 非常口 / locked = 鍵がかかっている / stay = 〜のままである

text.1: Me. Out in the corridor. From 18:10.
text.2: I went out into the corridor at 18:10.
text.3: I stepped out into the corridor at about ten past and stayed there.
text.4: I was already out in the corridor by then, so I saw nothing in the room.
text.5: The minute is a blur, but I had already gone out into the corridor by about ten minutes past six.

lie.hintJa: go out = 外へ出る / corridor = 廊下 / stay = とどまる

contradictions.meaningJa: Naoは18:10に部室から廊下へ出たと言うが、Junの段ボール箱が18:10から18:15まで部室の出入口を塞いでいた。Hinaの18:05の証言で入れ替えの時間帯が絞られ、Rikuの廊下の視界とSoraの視線と自販機の故障の証言で、その間に他の経路も使えなかったことが分かる。

text.3: I went down the stairs at about a quarter past six.
text.4: I had gone down to the ground floor by then, so I missed all of it.
text.5: I would not stake anything on the time, but I had gone down the stairs by around a quarter past six.

lie.hintJa: downstairs = 下の階へ / go down = 下りる / floor = 階

contradictions.meaningJa: Hinaは18:15に下の階へ行っていたと言うが、Naoは18:20より前に階段を下りた者はいないと言っている。Junの段ボール箱とSoraの視線とRikuの廊下の視界と自販機の故障の証言で、その時間帯に廊下から抜けられなかったことが分かる。

text.2: I was buying a drink at the vending machine at 18:15.
text.3: I was getting a drink from the vending machine at about a quarter past.
text.4: I had gone along to buy a drink by then, so I was not at our doorway.
text.5: I do not often bother with that machine, but I had gone along to buy a drink at around a quarter past six.

lie.hintJa: vending machine = 自動販売機 / drink = 飲み物 / along = 〜に沿って

contradictions.meaningJa: Rikuは18:15に自販機コーナーで飲み物を買っていたと言うが、自販機は18:05から故障していたという証言がある。Soraの窓の証言、Hinaの18:05の証言、Naoの廊下の視界、Junの段ボール箱で、その時間帯に部室と廊下の様子が確定する。

text.2: I was in the equipment room at 18:15.
text.3: I was in the equipment room looking for my old racket at a quarter past.
text.4: I was through in the equipment room, so I was nowhere near the shelf.
text.5: I would have to think about it, but I believe I was in the equipment room looking for my old racket at around a quarter past six.

lie.hintJa: equipment = 用具 / look for = 探す / racket = ラケット

contradictions.meaningJa: Junは18:15に用具室にいたと言うが、Soraは18:20まで用具室の扉を見ており、誰も入っていない。Hinaが18:10から棚を見ている者がいなくなったと言い、NaoとRikuの廊下の視界と自販機の故障の証言で、その直後の廊下の様子が分かる。

text.1: Me. Out the emergency exit. At 18:15.
text.2: I went out the emergency exit at 18:15.
text.3: I took the rubbish out that way at about a quarter past six.
text.4: I had stepped outside with the rubbish, so I was not in the room.
text.5: I do that every evening, so I would say I was outside with the rubbish at around a quarter past six.

lie.hintJa: emergency exit = 非常口 / rubbish = ごみ / take out = 外へ出す

contradictions.meaningJa: Soraは18:15に非常口から外へ出たと言うが、非常口は18:20まで施錠されていたという証言がある。Junの車が非常口の外に停まっていたこと、Naoの廊下の視界、Hinaの18:05の証言、Rikuの廊下の視界で、その時間帯に建物を出た者がいないことが分かる。

text.2: I was in the next room at 18:15.
text.3: I stepped into the next club's room at about a quarter past six.
text.4: I had gone into the next room on my round, so I saw nothing of the corridor.
text.5: My round takes me in there most evenings, and I had gone into the next club's room by about a quarter past six.

lie.hintJa: next door = 隣の / round = 見回り / step into = 中へ入る

contradictions.meaningJa: Ito氏は18:15に隣のサークルの部屋へ入ったと言うが、Rikuの運搬用ケースが18:10から18:20まで隣室の扉の内側に積まれており、人が入れる隙間はなかった。Hinaの18:05の証言で入れ替えの時間帯が絞られ、Naoの廊下の視界とJunの段ボール箱とSoraの視線で、その間に廊下を通った者がいないことが分かる。

timelineEn: 18:00 The club room opened and the trophy stood on the shelf.
18:05 The trophy was still on the shelf.
18:10 Everyone moved to the far side of the room and nobody watched the shelf.
18:15 The trophy was swapped for a cheap replica.
18:20 Someone looked at the shelf and saw the wrong cup.

keyExpressions.en: Hold on, something is missing here.
keyExpressions.ja: 待って、何かが抜けています。

keyExpressions.en: I have no memory of that.
keyExpressions.ja: それは記憶にありません。
どちらから行きましたか。
そこには近づいていません。
